🕺 Dancing Grandpa 🕺

Baby Entertainment System

This application has been restructured to support multiple build targets:

  • Desktop version targeting Windows MSVC build
  • Website version targeting WebAssembly
  • Common code shared between both versions

Each component now has its own independent Cargo.toml and configuration files.

dancing-grandpa/
├── common/ # Shared code library
├── desktop/ # Windows desktop application
└── website/ # WebAssembly web application

The WebAssembly version is currently under development.

Please check back later for the interactive version!
